description: A small library built from real MusicBrainz data, with a known answer for what's owned and missing. Each album exercises one matching path or edge case.

albums.why: Complete album with full MusicBrainz tags: the easy path.
Owned album with two tracks missing: shows as owned, with the missing tracks listed separately.
Live album with basic tags only: matched fuzzily, and owned even though live albums are hidden from the missing view.
No MusicBrainz IDs, but every track carries its ISRC: matched by ISRC.
Basic tags with messy folder names and title variations: matched fuzzily after normalisation.
Two-disc deluxe edition (10th anniversary) with one bonus track missing: owning a deluxe edition owns the album, and missing tracks are per disc.

strays.why: Right name, wrong length (75 seconds too long): fuzzy confidence falls under the threshold, so it goes to review.
A track that isn't in the catalogue at all.
strays.path: Daft Punk/Bootlegs/One More Time (Live at Wembley).mp3

policy.why: The missing view's default filters. The plan shows albums, EPs and singles and hides live albums, compilations, remixes, demos and soundtracks; real data also has interviews, mixtapes and DJ mixes, so any secondary type hides a group. Groups with no official release (bootlegs only) are hidden too.
